Notes shared by tables of this section.

  • Tables 2-S7.1, 2-S7.3, 2-S7.7 and 2-S7.12: Decision: each letter’s registered rule applied to its saved interval.
  • Tables 2-S7.1 to 2-S7.4, 2-S7.7, 2-S7.9, 2-S7.10 and 2-S7.12: N = 320 (Stereotypical, None, n = 55; Stereotypical, SMA, n = 52; Stereotypical, NCM, n = 60; Non-stereotypical, None, n = 52; Non-stereotypical, SMA, n = 50; Non-stereotypical, NCM, n = 51).
  • Tables 2-S7.3 and 2-S7.12: In the sensitivity analysis, N = 212 (Stereotypical, None, n = 32; Stereotypical, SMA, n = 33; Stereotypical, NCM, n = 45; Non-stereotypical, None, n = 36; Non-stereotypical, SMA, n = 29; Non-stereotypical, NCM, n = 37).
  • Tables 2-S7.5 and 2-S7.13: N = 319 (Stereotypical, None, n = 54; Stereotypical, SMA, n = 52; Stereotypical, NCM, n = 60; Non-stereotypical, None, n = 52; Non-stereotypical, SMA, n = 50; Non-stereotypical, NCM, n = 51); complete cases on the analyzed variables.

Table 2-S7.8

Global fit of the E4d–E4h model in the four sample and adjustment versions: scaled test statistic and indices as saved by the analysis

Version N chi2 df p chi2/df CFI TLI RMSEA RMSEA 90% CI SRMR
Note. χ² = mean- and variance-adjusted (scaled-and-shifted) χ² (WLSMV; lavaan test scaled.shifted), with its df and p; CFI = comparative fit index; TLI = Tucker-Lewis index; RMSEA = root mean square error of approximation (with 90% CI); SRMR = standardized root mean square residual. CFI, TLI and RMSEA (with its 90% CI) are computed from the scaled χ² (lavaan's .scaled indices). The RMSEA 90% CI uses lavaan’s scaled, rather than robust, RMSEA (fitMeasures(), robust = FALSE). It converts the noncentral χ² interval at the scaled statistic’s degrees of freedom to the RMSEA scale, including the multiple-group factor √G (G = 6 groups). lavaan estimator WLSMV (DWLS with robust.sem standard errors, theta parameterization); complete responses, as registered (registered analysis supplement). The statistics for legal-indirect primary adjusted come from a fit-statistics-only refit of the registered model with its estimator's default test, evaluated at the registered estimates (largest difference from them: 5.7e-14). The registration specifies no fit cutoffs for this model. N counts eligible participants. The legal-indirect primary unadjusted, sensitivity adjusted, and sensitivity unadjusted versions did not yield converged, admissible solutions under lavaan’s convergence and post-estimation checks. They therefore have no reported estimates, as required for original-sample results by the registered analysis supplement.
